agent_explanation: Shrunk case has one free body, no walls, no contacts, controller disabled and zero work, so only gravity acts. Semi-implicit Euler under constant gravity should update vy by exactly g*dt (~0.29/step) with no energy creation, but vy grows by ~1.74/step (6x too large) while vx is constant, so KE and total energy grow ~56J/step and breach energy_bound in 2 steps. The large dt (0.0295) at speed ~40 triggers 41-43 substeps per step; the substepped gravity/position update injects energy. Same scenario with dt=0.001 shows no growth and no violation, confirming a large-dt integration energy error, not a physical source.
